title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 6th November 2026
takeaway: Raws slipped back under steady selling while London whites held up, so the white premium firmed and the front white spread narrowed, a sign that refined sugar is relatively better supported than raw.

title: What Factors Influence Futures Market Spreads?
takeaway: A refreshed explainer: sugar spreads are set by crop seasonality, each exporter's own cost of carrying stock, the shape of the curve, physical premiums and the mechanics of expiries and index-fund rolls, which is useful framing for reading the current carry in No. 11.

title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 5th November 2026
takeaway: Speculative buying briefly lifted raws and whites off their lows but longs sold into the bounce, leaving the market consolidating rather than turning and the white premium little changed.

title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 4th November 2026
takeaway: Consumer buying and hedge lifting at lower prices steadied raws after the post-election drop, but with funds quiet there was no follow-through, which points to a floor being tested rather than a recovery.

title: US Sugar Remains Tight as Brazil Election Pressures Global Prices
takeaway: Lula's re-election weakened the real, which improves Brazilian export returns and pushed world raw futures lower, while the US domestic market stays firm on slow beet harvesting, weaker Florida cane, lost refining capacity and continued tariffs on Brazil.

title: The GLP-1 Effect Is Spreading
takeaway: Weight-loss drugs are cutting purchases of soft drinks, snacks and alcohol in rich markets and could reach big consumers like India, China and Brazil as generics get cheaper, a slow structural drag on sugar demand rather than a near-term price driver.

title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 3rd November 2026
takeaway: Speculative longs liquidated after the Brazilian election, breaking raws through the previous week's low and gapping whites lower, with the commentary seeing technical weakness and only scale-down buying from consumers and multinationals underneath.

title: US Ethanol Exports Poised for Growth in Mexico and Brazil
takeaway: A preliminary US-Mexico deal and talk of Brazil's Northeast resuming US ethanol imports from January point to more US exports; landed US ethanol after Brazil's tariff caps Northeast ethanol prices in the inter-harvest.

title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 9th November 2026
takeaway: Quiet, narrow raws session capped by spec long liquidation, while spot buying pulled the London December spread and lifted the white premium to its highest since mid-September.

title: US Sugar Prices Hold Firm Amid Tight Supply Outlook
takeaway: US cash sugar stays firm because sellers are withholding tonnage on crop doubts (incl. pest damage in Florida cane) while buyers defer; the domestic market remains decoupled from the world slide.

title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 10th November 2026
takeaway: Raws briefly traded below 18c for the first time since August on long liquidation with no physical buying; firm December white spreads kept London's lows intact.

title: CS Brazil: Sugar or Ethanol? 11th November 2026
takeaway: Weekly chart-only tracker of Centre-South mill sugar-versus-ethanol pay; no readable commentary on the free page.

title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 12th November 2026
takeaway: Both contracts dipped intraday and settled lower as speculators stayed sidelined after repeated whipsaws; the December white spread eased as open interest ran down ahead of expiry.

title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 13th November 2026
takeaway: Raws and whites both firmed into the week's close on small-trader buying; London December expired with a sizeable tender talked, and the white premium held near its recent highs.

title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 16th November 2026
takeaway: Raws stayed in their 18-18.5c band but closed toward the bottom as the real weakened; London March held just above its recent low, leaving a retest open.

title: Understanding Sugar Production
takeaway: Explainer on cane versus beet: cane is tropical, ratooned and milled to raws with bagasse as fuel; beet is temperate, harvested in autumn and processed straight to whites.

title: Futures and Market Data: 17th November 2026
takeaway: Speculators trimmed their net long mostly by selling longs while producers lifted hedges; raws stayed in a narrow range near 18c and the March/May roll is under way, with no strong directional call.

title: US Sugar Production Cuts Keep Domestic Prices Supported
takeaway: USDA's November cuts to both US beet and cane output (pests hit Louisiana and Florida cane) tighten the US domestic balance despite higher imports; users are holding off at high domestic prices, but sellers are not under pressure.

title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 17th November 2026
takeaway: Raws edged up but stayed in the 18c area; consumers would not chase strength and Brazilian growers priced only lightly with the real weak, so trade flow on both sides was thin.

title: Brazil Weather Widens the Near-Term Deficit
takeaway: Czarnikow cut its Centre-South and US crops and widened its 2026/27 world deficit, but frames the Brazil change as timing: rain-stopped cane stays in the field and lifts next season's start, so the 2027/28 crop was raised and the old-crop drawdown is cushioned by earlier surpluses.

title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 18th November 2026
takeaway: Raws dipped into the lows on long liquidation and fresh selling, then short covering trimmed the loss; whites eased on thin late volume. Funds did not press the sell side, and spread/premium interest was light.

title: Late Dry Spell Puts Queensland Cane Harvest Back on Track
takeaway: A grower's view from far north Queensland: dry weather let mills close out a badly delayed crush, but regrowth in the last cane cut its sugar content sharply, so Australian output and quality end the season on the soft side rather than with a late recovery.

title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 19th November 2026
takeaway: The 18c floor gave way: an early run at the prior low tripped fund sell stops, trade and consumer buying could not absorb it, and long liquidation carried raws and whites sharply lower with little chart support until much lower levels; the whites Mar/May slipped further into discount.
